structured.answer: It's savings the employer and I pay into from my salary, and the profits are tax-free if I wait 6 years (3 if I've reached pension age). It looks worth having because the employer adds money, but the money sits in shares that can fall, so I'll ask my son or the bank before I choose anything.

stuck.why: It suddenly compares with 'S&P 500' and a 'חשבון ניירות ערך', which I don't know, and I didn't understand why I need that
A slider I don't use, and amounts that seemed small for 10 years. I didn't understand what they were
A minus sign worried me. Can I lose money?
'המדינה לא ערבה לשווי הקרן': so it isn't safe like a deposit
